note: The PM's approval, written in advance, for systematic trades inside the mandate. A memo trades only if it passes every harness check, every book check AND these rules. Anything flagged waits for a manual PM sign-off (fund/policy/pm_approvals.json).

short_book.note: Crowded shorts are not added (squeeze risk). Unknown short interest goes to the PM.

hedge.note: Third book: a SPY position that brings beta-adjusted net exposure to the target. It protects the long and short books; it is not a view.
